source: ISPR / UNAMA / Dawn / Express Tribune / Khaama Press / The Nation / SCMP / The Hindu — August 18, 2026
delta: Aug 13: 38th UN Security Council Monitoring Team report finds Taliban relocated ~2,000 TTP fighters from the border and warned TTP leadership to halt Pakistan attacks, while terrorist threat from Afghanistan remains largely unchanged. Aug 14: gunmen ambush Balochistan Home Minister Mir Ziaullah Langove's convoy in Mastung (7 wounded, minister unhurt) and TTP rocket + gun attack on a Bajaur police post kills 1 officer. Aug 15: Taliban marks 5th anniversary of return to power; UN official warns of ongoing rights crisis. Aug 16: 724 humanitarian aid trucks cross the Af-Pak border in one of the largest recent convoys; security forces kill 7 TTP militants in a Kharan, Balochistan IBO under 'Radd-ul-Fitna 3'. Aug 17: TTP-linked gunmen kill a police constable in Bannu's Sorani area; Rangers/CTD arrest a TTP financier with Waziristan ties in Karachi. No formal ceasefire, no Urumqi Round 2 meeting confirmed; conflict remains in active low-intensity escalation.
